clues: This city is in the north of Portugal, in the old Minho lands. It is the chief town of the Ave area, a busy work zone.
This place sits in a valley ringed by hills, not far from the sea. The sea softens its hot summers, while winters turn cool and rainy with frost.
A warrior named Vimara Peres settled here in the ninth century and made it his seat of rule. He had won the land for the King of Galicia.
People call this place the birthplace of a whole country, since its first king was born here. A key battle near here helped start that kingdom, too.
Its old town centre is a World Heritage Site. It shows how a town from the Middle Ages grew into a town of today.
